title: Detector map on a real stream (Elec2)
description: The E04 detector matrix replayed on River's Elec2 electricity-market stream: real features and labels, 45,312 records. Rows are shuffled per seed and a known label-swap drift is injected at a fixed position in each of the four temporal shapes, so detection ground truth stays exact while the error stream keeps real-world class overlap and noise.

acceptance.note: acceptance is not evaluated on a truncated stream
